summary: BlackRock Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K to report two routine items: an unregistered sale of Institutional Class common shares exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S, with 376,795 shares sold on May 1, 2026 for $8,911,166.26 (price calculated as ~$23.65/share), and the declaration of a regular distribution payable May 28, 2026 and paid June 26, 2026. There is no strategic transaction, forced management change, or special situation. This is a standard periodic compliance filing for a private credit fund.
